appDesc.message: Professional subtitles for any video, in the language you choose, timed to the speech.

sourceNoneHint.message: Open a page with a video, or translate a file from your computer.

pickFile.message: Translate a file from your computer

started.message: Translation started. You can close this window.

empty.message: Nothing translated yet. Open any video and press Translate, or right-click any video link.

errQuota.message: The free Gemini quota is used up for today. It comes back tomorrow morning.

errKey.message: Gemini key is not set. Add it in Settings.

errDownload.message: Could not download the video from that link. Check that the link works.

errTools.message: ffmpeg is not installed on this computer.

offlineTitle.message: tarjim is not running on this computer

offlineBody.message: Start it with this command, then come back:

offlineWindows.message: Double-click the tarjim shortcut on your desktop (or find tarjim in the Start menu) to start it, then come back here.

pairWrong.message: That token is not right. Check it and try again.

dropHint.message: Any video or audio from your computer, in any language.

badFile.message: That file is not a video or audio file.

voiceClone.message: Each speaker's own voice (on your computer)

errDub.message: No dubbing voice for this language yet. Try subtitles instead.

keyShape.message: That does not look like a key. Check that you copied all of it.

keyRejected.message: Google refused this key. Check that you copied all of it.

keySet.message: Set. Type a new key to replace it.

pairManual.message: Or paste the security token by hand:

pairWaiting.message: On the tarjim page, type this code and press Allow:

menuDubClone.message: Dub in the speaker's own voice (local)

menuOther.message: Another language or a file on this computer

menuNoVideo.message: Could not find a video link on this page.

notifyStarted.message: Translation started. You will be notified when it finishes.

pairedNotice.message: The extension is connected. You can translate now.

setupBody.message: Open the setup page and go step by step: language, your device, connecting an AI, and tools. You can come back to it any time from Settings.

errSignin.message: Your AI subscription needs you to sign in again. Open tarjim, go to Settings, sign in, then try again.

errAccount.message: The AI company refused this account: it says the account is not eligible or must be verified first. This is on the company's side, not tarjim's. Open its own program or site and finish the verification it asks for, or choose another AI in Settings (a free Gemini key works right away).

errMedia.message: This file is not a video or sound file tarjim can open. Choose the video file itself, not a playlist or a list of links.

errLong.message: This file holds more than six hours of sound, the most tarjim works on. Cut it into parts of up to six hours and translate each part on its own.

errList.message: This link is a list of several videos, such as a playlist, a channel or a feed. tarjim works on one video at a time: open the video you want and send its own link.

errUpdated.message: tarjim was updated while it was running and restarts by itself in a moment. Then press “Try again”.

voiceElevenClone.message: ElevenLabs, the speaker's own voice (sends a voice sample)

voiceSpeech.message: Your linked voice service (sends the text only)

removeLabel.message: Remove from the list. The video and subtitle files stay in your folder.

removed.message: Removed from the list. The files are still in your folder.

engineNone.message: No other translator is ready. Add one in Settings.

engineSaved.message: Saved. The next translation uses it.

qualityFailed.message: Couldn't read the qualities, so 1080p or the nearest below it will be downloaded.
